ai.title: Let AI Concierge turn your party needs into a quote request
ai.intro: One question at a time. AI uses age, guest count, budget, theme preference, and venue status to recommend Castle, Space, or Forest, choose a package tier, use Restaurant A as a sample, and pre-fill the quote request.
ai.safetyNote: No paid TTS, no real voice upload, and no payment, webhook, n8n, or outbound message is triggered.
ai.compareThemes: I compare the three themes with the same package logic
ai.restaurantPlaceholderCopy: English mode hides Chinese-labelled rendering images and uses a clean layout summary.

prefill.themeLocked: I have saved this theme first.

interaction.title: Tell me your idea, and I will turn it into a quote-ready brief
interaction.copy: Type naturally like you are talking to a human planner. The page uses local rules to detect age, style, budget, and missing details. No external AI is called.
interaction.placeholder: Example: My daughter is turning 18. I want it to feel elegant, not childish, photo-friendly, and not too expensive.
interaction.voicePreview: Browser speech + text fallback / Local only

speech.title: Say one party planning request
speech.idle: Press start and the browser will ask for microphone permission, then convert speech to text locally in the browser.
speech.processing: I heard you. Organizing the request now.
speech.unsupported: This browser does not support native SpeechRecognition. Text input is available.
speech.fallback: Type the request in the text box below and the same flow will continue.
speech.localOnly: Local/staging only. No recording upload and no external speech service.
speech.startFailed: The browser could not start speech recognition. Please use text input.

conversation.title: Plan with a step-by-step AI party advisor
conversation.copy: AI asks one question, you answer by speech or text, then the local rules understand known details and move to the next missing item.
conversation.noFieldsYet: I have not detected enough details yet.
conversation.textPlaceholder: Example: I need help planning a 7-year-old birthday for around 20 guests, standard budget, and no venue yet.
conversation.summaryText: I will plan around {theme}, age {age}, {guests} guests, {budget} budget, {venue}, and recommend {package}.
conversation.themePrefilled: Current theme is already selected: {theme}. I will keep it and continue with the next missing detail.

steps.intro: Hi, I am the Party Event AI party advisor. I will help you plan step by step. You can say: I do not know this app well, please help me plan.
steps.intent: Do you want me to recommend a plan, or do you already have a theme you like?
steps.theme: Do you prefer Castle Princess, Space Explorer, Forest Adventure, or should I recommend one?
steps.guests: About how many guests will attend?
steps.budget: Is the budget closer to Basic, Standard, Premium, or not sure yet?
steps.venue: Do you already have a venue, or do you need venue recommendations?
steps.special: Any special needs, such as cake, balloons, photography, kids entertainment, allergies, or dietary requirements?
steps.summary: I have enough details to create a quote-ready planning summary.

quotePage.title: Quote summary
quotePage.subtitle: Confirm your party plan
quotePage.trustTitle: A reviewable estimate, not an automatic charge
quotePage.trustCopy: This amount helps customers understand budget, scope, and next steps. A final quote still needs human review of date, guest count, venue availability, and supplier availability.
quotePage.trustPointEstimate: The estimate shows major line items so parents can compare packages and adjustments.
quotePage.trustPointReview: Submitting an inquiry enters human review and does not create a formal order automatically.
quotePage.trustPointPayment: Deposit and payment remain readiness / placeholder only; no real payment is triggered.
quotePage.lineItemsTitle: What stable line item types make up the quote
quotePage.lineItemsCopy: Venue, decor, supplier, labor, transport, service, and optional upgrade costs are captured in the quote snapshot for review.
quotePage.lineItemGenericDescription: Local/staging estimate component for customer review.
quotePage.visualBasisCopy: Theme decor layer and dining-room flow used for the quote estimate.
quotePage.view3dPreview: View experimental 3D scene preview (not a construction drawing)
quotePage.addonsLead: Add services only when they solve a real parent problem: less setup work, stronger photos, better kids engagement, or a cleaner venue handover. They remain staging estimates until a planner reviews availability.
quotePage.foodNotesPlaceholder: Example: shared banquet, kids menu, vegetarian options, or bring-your-own food questions
quotePage.allergyNotesPlaceholder: Example: nut-free, halal, gluten-free, egg allergy, or no known allergies
quotePage.culturalRequirementsPlaceholder: Example: halal-friendly, no pork, no alcohol, vegetarian, prayer-friendly timing, or other family requirements
quotePage.cakeNeedsPlaceholder: Example: need a cake supplier, bring own cake, dessert table, or cupcake tower
quotePage.parentPrioritiesPlaceholder: Example: easy setup, beautiful photos, quiet private room, parking, or low mess
quotePage.noticeEstimate: * Prices are estimates and may change based on date, guest count, venue, and supplier availability.
quotePage.noticeFollowup: After inquiry submission, a planner can follow up manually in staging.
quotePage.aiPrefillBody: AI Concierge prefilled contact, date, guest count, budget, venue preference, and recommendation notes. Confirming only submits a local/staging inquiry skeleton.
quotePage.flowBody: Confirm the theme, package, and Restaurant A visual context, then submit an inquiry skeleton. No real payment is triggered.
quotePage.requiredError: Please complete required fields: name, contact method, and event date.
quotePage.backendSaved: Inquiry saved and synced to local Lead API skeleton ({id}).
quotePage.localSavedBackendFailed: Inquiry saved in local browser; Lead API skeleton sync is not available.
quotePage.submitFailure: Local save failed. Check browser storage and retry.
quotePage.syncFailed: Saved in browser; Lead API skeleton sync is unavailable, demo can continue.
quotePage.localSaved: Saved in browser for staging demo and customer path explanation.
quotePage.receivedSummary: The team can manually review venue, theme, and supplier availability, then show quote progress on the customer side.
quotePage.receivedItem1: The team can confirm the plan using Restaurant A, theme visuals, and supplier suggestions.
quotePage.receivedItem2: You can view quote progress in My Quotes.
quotePage.receivedItem3: You can view later order status in My Orders.
quotePage.receivedItem4: This is a staging preview and does not trigger real payment, webhook, n8n, or outbound messages.
quotePage.localizedPackageCopy: This package is shown as a local/staging estimate. Final scope requires human review.
quotePage.localizedPackagePoint1: Decor, venue, and supplier scope affect the final estimate.
